person.name: Hardi Jain
person.description: SaaS product manager and Chartered Accountant. B2C checkout, B2B merchant self-serve and enterprise platform work at PayU, now building with AI.

pages.title: Hardi Jain | SaaS & AI-Enabled Product Manager
pages.description: Hardi Jain, SaaS product manager and Chartered Accountant. Read my case studies in B2C checkout, B2B payment links and platform delivery.

pages.title: SaaS product case studies: B2C, B2B, enterprise | Hardi Jain
pages.description: Seven product management case studies from a payments SaaS platform: checkout conversion, EMI, payment links, access control and cross-squad delivery.

pages.title: Checkout conversion drop traced to bot traffic | Hardi Jain
pages.description: Payment success rate fell from 65% to 60% on a 10M-user checkout. How funnel analysis found bot traffic, and why invisible detection beat CAPTCHA.

pages.title: Down payment + EMI for high-value checkout | Hardi Jain
pages.description: B2C case study: letting customers pay part upfront and the rest in EMIs on purchases above ₹50,000, to cut drop-off on high-ticket checkouts.

pages.title: Partial payments for school fee payment links | Hardi Jain
pages.description: B2B2C case study: schools set how much parents pay first, so fee collection through payment links stopped depending on one full upfront payment.

pages.title: Cross-platform payment UX standardization | Hardi Jain
pages.description: B2B case study: mapping components onto live payment journeys to find where two surfaces behaved differently, then turning each gap into a requirement.

pages.title: Self-serve payment links for merchants | Hardi Jain
pages.description: B2B SaaS case study: moving payment link customization out of the engineering queue and into a merchant configuration layer: configure, preview, share.

pages.title: Payment link access control for sales agents | Hardi Jain
pages.description: Enterprise SaaS case study: a scoped workspace that lets external sales agents create payment links without seeing the rest of the business.

pages.title: Cross-squad delivery on a payments platform | Hardi Jain
pages.description: Enterprise case study: when several squads built on one product surface, a shared readiness check and quality gate fixed what looked like a capacity problem.

pages.title: Audit reconciliation automation case study | Hardi Jain
pages.description: How repeated reconciliation logic became a reusable system, so auditors could investigate exceptions instead of repeating calculations.

pages.title: Fund operations and NAV reporting automation | Hardi Jain
pages.description: Daily capital calls and quarterly NAV reporting, automated from one upload, cutting processing from two business days to under four hours.

pages.title: From audit to SaaS product and AI | Hardi Jain
pages.description: Five chapters from internal and statutory audit through automation to SaaS product management and AI, and the thread that connects them.

pages.title: How I work: product management principles | Hardi Jain
pages.description: Six product principles: empathy first, data as a decision tool, moments that matter, progress over perfection, speed with trust, systems over features.
